evidence.excerpt: let Ok(text) = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes) else { // Non-text content is not indexable; it never enters the manifest, so later refreshes reconsider it. return Ok(()); };

subject: src/index/refresh.rs::classify_working
text: Working-tree index refresh handles non-UTF-8 content gracefully: when from_utf8 on the exact bytes fails, the file is skipped from the manifest with Ok(()) rather than failing the refresh.
